paper_title: Before Generation, Align it! A Novel and Effective Strategy for   Mitigating Hallucinations in Text-to-SQL Generation
caption: Results of different schema linking modules on BIRD-dev.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates a comparison of performance metrics across three categories for three different models or configurations. The horizontal axis lists the categories: Recall, Precision, and F1 Score. The vertical axis represents the performance values, ranging from 40 to 100, with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 20. The chart features three groups of bars, each representing a model/configuration: DIN-SQL (zero-shot) in light blue, TA-SQL (zero-shot) in blue, and DIN-SQL (few-shot) in green. For Recall, the bars are approximately 63.58 for DIN-SQL (zero-shot), 71.90 for TA-SQL (zero-shot), and 72.29 for DIN-SQL (few-shot). For Precision, the bars are approximately 88.89 for DIN-SQL (zero-shot), 91.24 for TA-SQL (zero-shot), and 92.31 for DIN-SQL (few-shot). For F1 Score, the bars are approximately 75.34 for DIN-SQL (zero-shot), 80.40 for TA-SQL (zero-shot), and 81.08 for DIN-SQL (few-shot). The bars are not sorted in a specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color coding.
